products.name: Pharmacy ERP
products.tagline: Medicines, batches and the counter, with the books kept for you.
products.description: For retail pharmacies, medical stores and pharmaceutical wholesalers: medicine catalogue, batch and expiry tracking, purchasing and receiving, dispensing and sales at the counter, prescriptions, and accounting in Finance.

products.name: Retail & Trading ERP
products.tagline: Retail and wholesale trading on one set of books.
products.description: For retail stores, supermarkets, wholesalers and trading companies: point of sale, quotations, orders, invoices, delivery notes, purchasing, stock and accounting.

products.name: Education ERP
products.tagline: Admissions to results, fees to the general ledger.
products.description: For schools, colleges and universities: admissions, classes, attendance, examinations, student fees, staff and accounting.

products.name: NGO ERP
products.description: For NGOs and development organizations: programs and projects, donors and grants, budgets, expenses, procurement, staff and fund accounting.

products.name: Finance & Accounting
products.tagline: The shared accounting module, on its own.
products.description: Chart of accounts, journals, receivables, payables, banking and financial statements: the same Finance application every ERP product posts to.
